tools.name: latest_releases
tools.description: Newest Canadian government news releases (federal, provincial, territorial) from the last 7 days, newest first, up to 5. Optionally filter by jurisdiction and topic.

jurisdiction.description: Limit to one government, e.g. "federal", "alberta", "ontario". Omit for all of Canada.

topic.description: Limit to one policy topic, e.g. "healthcare", "energy". Call list_jurisdictions_and_topics for every id.

tools.name: search_releases
tools.description: Keyword search over Canadian government news releases from the last 7 days. Every word must appear in the headline or summary. Returns up to 5 matches, newest first.

jurisdiction.description: Limit to one government, e.g. "federal", "alberta", "ontario". Omit for all of Canada.

topic.description: Limit to one policy topic, e.g. "healthcare", "energy". Call list_jurisdictions_and_topics for every id.

tools.name: list_jurisdictions_and_topics
tools.description: Lists the jurisdiction ids and policy topic ids Government Radar can filter releases by.
